# Moody Spurgeon MacPherson

[Academy](../codex/places.md#academy)

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P33](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is a funny-looking boy. He possesses a big, fat face paired with little blue eyes, and his ears stick out prominently like flaps.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## Personality

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is driven by his goal of becoming a minister, though he has at times despaired that he was born to disappoint his parents and reflected that carpentry might be an easier path. He is plagued by anxiety over his academic performance, particularly fearing that he will fail English history.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P20](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0020)_

## History

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson pursued his education alongside his fellow [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classmates under Miss Stacy's instruction, preparing for higher academics. He traveled to town with his peers to take the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy). After passing the exams, Moody Spurgeon continued his studies at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) in town, attending classes alongside the other students from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P1](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXVI.
